{"reason": "6 of 8 false arbitrations show confidence < 0.7 (0.66, 0.44, 0.60, 0.67, 0.67, 0.61), so v1 arbitrates low-confidence EDI swings. Added a high-confidence? gate before the frozen check; this removes those false positives while retaining confident signals, cutting false-arbitration-rate from 0.714.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
